t.name: Deadfall Trail #849
t.description: This 1.6 mile trail starts from Deadfall trailhead off Forest Road 28.060 and ends when it meets Snow Creek Trail #890 at 1.6 miles. Generally steep, the trail traverses dense second growth forest.

t.name: Falls View Canyon Trail #868
t.description: This one mile second-growth forest canyon trail leads to Big Quilcene River among spring blooming rhododendrons, lilies, and honeysuckle.

t.name: Elbo Creek Trail #892.1
t.description: This moderate 2.5 mile forested trail ascends through to the top of a storm blow down with nice views. Some difficult sections. A great place to observe a variety of plant life in the late spring and summer.

t.name: Mt. Walker Trail #894
t.description: A 2 mile steep, forested hike through Douglas-fir, spring blooming pacific rhododendrons, salal, and Oregon Grape to the north summit of Mt. Walker.

t.name: Notch Pass Trail #831
t.description: Hiker trail only. Hike through dense conifer forest on a trail constructed in the 1930's by Civilian Conservation Corps trail crews and get glimpses of the Olympic peaks including Mt. Constance.

t.name: Falls View Loop Trail #848
t.description: The short Falls View Loop Trail is adjacent to Falls View Canyon Trail and leads to a view of the cascading waterfall into the Big Quilcene River.

t.name: Big Quilcene Trail #833
t.description: This 5.3 mile trail travels along the Big Quilcene River through old growth forest and climbs to alpine meadows in Buckhorn Wilderness.
